mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as the low-rate environment supports valuation expansion without immediate policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 5.0% signals persistent price pressures, triggering aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes that depress S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate rapidly.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), declining payroll employment signals deepening labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production above 100 indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO remains above 100.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts decline exceeding 2.0% signals residential sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines by more than 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and CPI inflation indicate aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through higher discount rates and recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% YoY), declining industrial production signals supply chain disruption, compressing corporate margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% YoY.
